title: add-ci-artifact-signing-provenance-release-manifests-private-installer
author: Avery Chen
description: Add CI pipelines and release artifacts for Private Installer: generate SBOMs with syft, sign artifacts with cosign, produce release manifests (intoto/Provenance) and upload manifest bundles alongside installer artifacts; motivation: required for compliance customers and to enable reproducible on-prem installs; changes touch CI workflows, Helm chart metadata, Terraform module outputs, and release publishing; Checklist: [x] syft SBOM generation for all images and helm charts; [x] cosign signing integrated into release pipeline (GHA) with KMS-backed keys; [x] release manifest generator (intoto layout + provenance JSON) and upload to releases bucket; [x] helm Chart.yaml annotations with provenance URL; [x] terraform outputs updated to expose artifact URLs and signatures; [x] upgrade/rollback notes and integration test for signed manifests; Not included: rotation automation for long-lived signing keys (follow-up ENG-2362).
commits: feat(ci): add syft-based sbom generation for installer images
feat(ci): integrate cosign signing step and upload signatures to release bucket
chore(release): add release-manifests generator and upload job
fix(helm): add provenance annotations to Chart.yaml and values schema
feat(terraform): expose artifact_urls and signature metadata in module outputs
test(ci): add e2e smoke verifying signed manifests during release flow
ci_checks: github-actions/ci: failed on first run (integration tests flaky) then rerun passed
review_comments: Diego: Please add a note about cosign key rotation and where keys are stored (KMS) - actioned in security/README
Priya: Can we add chart provenance annotations to Chart.yaml so Helm shows provenance? - updated Chart.yaml to include provenance.url and provenance.sig
Maya: e2e test is brittle on small clusters, added retry and shortened image pulls - test updated
Avery: responded with details about KMS-backed ephemeral signing in docs and linked follow-up ENG-2362
release_notes: Private Installer: Release artifacts now include SBOMs and cryptographic signatures
Release manifests (intoto provenance + bundle) published alongside installer artifacts for reproducible installs
Terraform outputs updated to expose signed artifact URLs for installer automation
Helm Chart metadata now contains provenance annotations to aid auditing and automated verification
